# Security Policy

We take security seriously, and we strive to keep our software as secure as possible.  
That being said, nothing is ever 100% secure. If you've found a potential security issue, we'd love to know about it.

## Reporting security issues

Please report security issues privately, never in a public issue, discussion, or Discord channel.

- **Preferred:** open the [Security tab](https://github.com/TheSharks/WildBeast/security) and choose **Report a vulnerability**. This creates a private advisory that only the maintainers can see.
- Alternatively, email us at `security@thesharks.xyz`.

We'll determine a course of action from that point onward, and we'll strive to keep you updated at least once every 2 weeks.

## Supported versions

We're interested in issues for the current major release, code in the default branch, and code in any active development branch.
